purpose: Comparative research layer for extremist, terrorist, hate-group and controversial/new-religious-movement records. Classifications are source- and jurisdiction-dependent.
classification_rules: hate-group is not synonymous with terrorist organization
cult is a contested descriptive label and is never treated as a universal scientific category
historical organizations are separated from active organizations
membership estimates require a dated source and methodology
chapters/locations are not equivalent to members

records.name: Ku Klux Klan
records.membership: No authoritative single current membership figure
records.notes: Historical movement with multiple successor organizations and long-running racial violence history.

records.name: Aryan Brotherhood
records.notes: Prison-based criminal organization; membership and influence vary by facility and period.

records.name: Hammerskins
records.notes: Network historically associated with racist skinhead organizing.

records.name: Blood & Honour
records.notes: Developed from the British white-power music scene and later spread internationally.

records.name: Combat 18
records.notes: Historically linked to violent neo-Nazi organizing; status varies by jurisdiction and period.

records.name: National Action
records.notes: UK proscription status must be kept separate from broader media descriptions.

records.name: Atomwaffen Division
records.notes: Accelerationist network associated with violent extremist propaganda and plots; successor structures must be modeled separately.

records.name: The Base
records.notes: Transnational accelerationist network; legal designation varies by jurisdiction.

records.name: Active Club Network
records.locations_note: SPLC publicly documented numerous U.S. locations in its 2024 white-nationalist hate-group mapping.
records.notes: Location counts should be stored as observed chapters/locations, not membership.

records.name: American Freedom Party
records.notes: Political organization associated with white-nationalist ideology.

records.name: Proud Boys
records.notes: Classification and legal treatment vary by source and jurisdiction; chapters and individual prosecutions must be modeled separately.

records.name: Nation of Islam
records.membership: Published estimates vary substantially and should not be treated as exact
records.notes: Not equivalent to a terrorist organization; classification differs across sources and historical periods.

records.name: Islamic State / ISIS
records.membership: No single reliable global current figure
records.notes: Model central organization and regional affiliates as separate nodes.

records.name: Al-Qaeda
records.membership: No single reliable global current figure
records.notes: Model core and affiliates separately; avoid adding unsupported operational links.

records.name: Al-Shabaab
records.membership: Estimates vary by source and date
records.notes: Insurgency and terrorism classifications can coexist; preserve both dimensions.

records.name: Boko Haram
records.membership: Estimates vary by faction and period
records.notes: Separate Boko Haram/JAS and Islamic State West Africa structures where evidence supports it.

records.name: Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK)
records.notes: Designation differs across jurisdictions; model political, military and legal classifications separately.

records.name: Hamas
records.notes: Political, social and armed structures should not be collapsed into a single membership number.

records.name: Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam
records.status: defeated as territorial insurgency; residual diaspora activity disputed
records.notes: Historical-active distinction is essential.

records.name: Aum Shinrikyo
records.notes: Useful case for studying the transition from new religious movement to violent organization.

records.name: Peoples Temple
records.membership: Historical membership estimated in contemporary records
records.notes: Defunct movement; Jonestown should be modeled as a later site/event rather than current headquarters.

records.name: Heaven's Gate
records.notes: Defunct; 1997 mass death event is a separate historical event node.

records.name: Branch Davidians
records.notes: Waco 1993 siege is a separate historical event and should not be treated as the whole movement.

current_metrics_note: For active numbers, maintain separate fields for organization count, chapter/location count, arrests/incidents, and people estimates. Do not convert one metric into another.
